description: GRC DCOMbobulator: Legacy utility for checking and enabling/disabling the historical Windows DCOM vulnerability mitigation.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.
Designed for legacy Windows versions and old DCOM vulnerabilities. Changing DCOM can disrupt applications; not recommended for routine use on modern Windows.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for DCOMbobulator.' }
